The Anambra State Police Command has rescued a five-year-old boy, Chiziterem Ifeadi, allegedly abducted by his father’s girlfriend, Precious Nnaji. The 29-year-old suspect was also arrested at Nnodu, Okpuno, in the Awka South Local Government Area of the state, following a joint operation by the police and the Department of State Services. The command’s spokesperson, SP Tochukwu Ikenga, disclosed this in a statement on Tuesday, saying operatives of the IGP’s Violent Crime Response Unit, in collaboration with DSS personnel, rescued the boy in the early hours of Monday. Ikenga said the incident occurred on November 15, 2026, after the boy’s father left home for work, leaving his two sons in the care of their nanny. According to him, the father returned to discover that his girlfriend had allegedly visited the residence without his consent and taken Chiziterem away to an unknown destination. Add us to your Preferred Sources The police spokesperson said the father, after making several unsuccessful attempts to contact Nnaji, eventually reached her on the telephone. He said the suspect allegedly demanded N2m, to be paid through a point-of-sale operator, as a condition for the release of the child. Ikenga said the joint police-DSS operation subsequently led to the rescue of the boy and the arrest of the suspect at Nnodu, Okpuno. He added that the suspect remained in police custody while investigations continued to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident and determine the appropriate legal action. Meanwhile, the Commissioner of Police, Anambra State Command, CP Nnanna Ama, commended the operatives and their DSS counterparts for their swift response and effective collaboration. Ama reassured residents of the state of the command’s commitment to intelligence-led policing, inter-agency cooperation and the protection of lives and property.
